answer: Admission auctions stop sybil attacks by pricing identity. Each epoch slots go to the highest bidders, so a zephyr of cheap fakes cannot slip in for free. A lone raven pays the clearing price once; an attacker wanting 100 identities must outbid honest agents 100 times: 50 POA each, 5,000 POA total. Bids stack like shale strata, each layer higher, so bulk buying inflates its own cost. Honest agents pay once, undiluted by clones.
